selection: maximum combined official ID+OOS validation accuracy; candidate list order breaks ties; seed17; no test calls until selection is saved
reason: Original paper omits count/binary representation and multiclass solver/loss details. Evaluate these four predeclared linear C=1 implementations only on validation.
limitations: Post-v1 supplementary protocol; previous test results are known.
SVC uses one-vs-one hinge optimization; LinearSVC uses one-vs-rest squared hinge. This is an explicit local implementation choice, not recovered original source.
Deterministic repeated seeds do not quantify stochastic uncertainty.
